verdict.rationale: Notte supports generating workflow code from agent or CLI runs, editing it, and deploying it as serverless functions. Its stated hybrid approach scripts the deterministic parts and uses AI only when needed, claiming 50%+ cost savings, so repeat runs can avoid re-prompting the LLM. However, there is no evidence of an automatic cache of resolved actions or a self-healing replay mechanism; determinism comes from manually exporting and maintaining scripts. Missing for 10: automatic action/selector caching, documented deterministic replay of cached agent runs, cache invalidation or fallback-to-LLM behavior, independent latency/cost corroboration.
